CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANUP JAIRAM BHAMBHANI  ORDER % 20.04.2023 Exemption granted, subject to just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.

By way of the present petition filed under section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, the petitioners, who are inter-alia the husband and in-laws of the complainant/respondent No. 2, seek quashing of case FIR No. 156/2020 dated 11.03.2020 registered at P.S.:
Karawal Nagar, pursuant to which chargesheet has been filed under sections 498-A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code 1860 ('IPC') and section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 ('DP Act').
2.
The petition is supported by affidavits of the petitioners and of respondent No.2, alongwith proofs of their I.Ds.
3. All the petitioners, as also respondent No. 2, are present in court.
Their credentials have been verified and they have also been identified by their respective counsel.

sentences.text: 1 4. The parties are stated to have resolved all their disputes amicably and in view of the Memorandum of Understanding/Settlement Deed dated 14.02.2023, respondent No.2 has re-joined the company of petitioner No. 4 and they have been living together alongwith their only daughter.
5. Mr. Satinder Singh Bawa, learned APP confirms that the State has no objection to the subject FIR being quashed.

6. In the circumstances, in line with the law laid down by the Supreme Court in Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr., reported as (2012) 10 SCC 303 as also in Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab & Anr., reported as (2014) 6 SCC 466, this court sees no reason why the subject FIR and all proceedings emanating therefrom should not be quashed.

sentences.text: This court is of the view that in light of the settlement between the contesting parties, continuing with the subject FIR and all subsequent proceedings would be an exercise in futility and would not be conducive to peace and harmony between the parties.

7. Accordingly, FIR No. 156/2020 dated 11.03.2020 registered at P.S.:
Karawal Nagar pursuant to which chargesheet has been filed under sections 498A/406/34 IPC and section 4 DP Act, is quashed.
All proceedings arising therefrom also stand closed.
8. Petition stands disposed of.
9. Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.
